name: sheet-wraps-at-phone-width
note: U5 (ui-ux-polish-20261008): the song-view practice sheet wraps chord-lyric rows at the measured character budget (sheetWrapMaxChars, shared with the Stage) instead of overflowing sideways inside its overflow-x:auto box. Measured pre-change at Pixel 5: Mr. Jones 742px in a 329px box, Refugee 723, Roxanne 704. Pins the Lyrics/Both view (default) on three long-line catalog songs.
